name: Angled Palm
description: Set the palm at a measured angle to the target's centre so the force enters exactly where it is aimed.

name: Angled Shield
description: Tilt a plate of crystal qi at the best angle so a blow loses much of its weight on the slope.

name: Angled Step
description: Step on a measured slant and cross the gap in a line cut as true as a ruler.

name: Measured Cast
description: Figure the angle to the target and cast a crystal point that arrives with no wasted flight.

name: Measured Eye
description: Take the exact distance and bearing of every nearby body by their reflections in crystal qi.

name: Angled Redirect
description: Turn a blow at a clean angle off a crystal plate and strike the attacker's open side in the same motion.

name: Angled Cut
description: Cut along a measured line with an edge of crystal that pierces the guard and breaks the opponent's rhythm.

name: Setting Fist
description: Punch so that liquid qi sets hard on the knuckles at the instant of contact.

name: Setting Shell
description: Set a shell of qi to crystal on the front of the body between the blow and the breath.

name: Setting Stride
description: Set a pad of crystal under each foot as it falls and stride lightly over it.

name: Setting Spike
description: Set a spike of crystal in the air a pace from the hand and let it shoot forward at the foe.

name: Setting Clasp
description: Set a clasp of crystal round an opponent's ankle so the foot is fixed for a few breaths.

name: Setting Splint
description: Set a clear crystal around an ally's wound to seal the edges and hold the flesh together.

name: Rapid Lock
description: Set crystal round both of the opponent's arms in a breath so they are locked at the sides.

name: Setting Burst
description: Set a dense cluster of crystal in a ring that bursts outward and cuts all who stand near.

name: Specular Palm
description: Strike with a palm faced in polished crystal that flashes at the instant of the blow.

name: Specular Veil
description: Hold a polished plane before the body to bounce a thrown thing or a flash of qi away.

name: Specular Step
description: Step across a bright plane and leave the opponent aiming at the reflection left behind.

name: Mirror Glimpse
description: Angle a polished plane to see round a corner or over a shoulder.

name: Mirror Return
description: Catch a blow on the polished plane and send it back along the line it came with the same force.

name: Mirror Dazzle
description: Throw a hard bright flash off the plane into the opponent's eyes until they cannot tell friend from shadow.

name: Armoured Fist
description: Strike with a fist sheathed in a close crystal gauntlet that adds its own hardness to the blow.

name: Armour Plate
description: Grow a single plate of crystal over the chest and shoulder in the instant before impact.

name: Armour Pace
description: Walk forward under a light crystal mail that does not drag on the legs.

name: Armour Sliver
description: Shed a sliver of the armour and fling it straight at the target as a small hard dart.

name: Armour Reading
description: Feel through the crystal mail where blows are about to land and which joints are open.

name: Armour Mend
description: Grow a layer of clear crystal over a friend's torn side to close the wound beneath.

name: Armour Grown
description: Grow plate after plate of crystal across the body until a full suit stands against every blow.

name: Armour Counter
description: Take a blow on the crystal mail and shed a burst of edged shards back at the attacker.

name: Armour Shared
description: Grow a share of crystal armour over the ally beside the user so the pair stand against the same blow.

name: Geode Fist
description: Throw a closed fist whose outer shell cracks open on impact and shows a rough crystal beneath.

name: Geode Shell
description: Close the qi round the body in a rough stone shell that holds against a heavy swing.

name: Geode Step
description: Roll forward as a rounded stone and open into a stride at the end of the roll.

name: Geode Chip
description: Break a chip from the shell and send it spinning into the target.

name: Geode Glow
description: Open a small hollow in the shell and let the crystal light inside reveal what hides nearby.

name: Geode Sheath
description: Close a small geode of clear crystal round an ally's wound to hold it shut while it mends.

name: Geode Crack
description: Split the shell before the opponent's face with a sharp crack that rattles their attention.

name: Geode Burst
description: Open the shell outward in one burst of crystal that cuts every body near the user.

name: Geode Hold
description: Hold the closed shell round the user through a long assault and let it thicken as it takes blows.

name: Geode Filter
description: Grow a fine crystal sieve round an ally's wound to draw out poison and leave the blood clean.
